parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt:
Tell me about the last time you listened to a good piece of music?
2 weeks ago, I attended a music concert and I had a chance to listen to "Symphony No.9" . It had a fast beat with a haunting melody. What a masterpiece!

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Question 1: When and why do you listen to music?
I'm in the habit of listening to music when I am in a bad mood. Music helps me relax and relieve all stress, letting me be immersed in a strangely peaceful world where I can be myself.
Question 2: I have a ten-year-old son and I want him to learn to play music, but he doesn't want to. What can I do to change his mind?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
"As you know, we regularly hold concerts at our clubs in the evenings. Unfortunately, there have been complaints from people living in the area. If we don't do something about this situation, maybe we will have to stop the concerts. I would like to know what you think about this and what can we do to solve this problem? "
Email 1 : Email to your friend
Hi Tina,
How's it going?
Do you know that there have been complaints from people living in the area about our concert?
I think we can install soundproof glass inside the hall to prevent the noise. Or else, we can restrict the time frame to avoid disturbing the neighborhood.
What do you think bro?
Love,
Mia
Email 2 : Email to the club manager
Dear Manager,
My name is Jennie and I have been a club’s member for 2 months. I am writing this email in response to your latest email about the club’s issue.
According to the news, there have been complaints from people living in the area about our concert?
I would venture some of my suggestions. I think we should install the soundproof glasses inside the hall with a view to prevent the noise from escaping. Alternatively, we can restrict the time frame to avoid disturbing residents in the neighborhood. Specifically, ending time should be adjusted from 11p.m to 10p.m, which is 1 hour earlier than scheduled.
I look forward to hearing from you if my ideas are acceptable
Sincerely,
Jennie.
